turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any bumps, sores, or unusual spots on my scalp. I haven’t had any rash or skin issues anywhere else either.”

turns.patient_answer: "No, I haven’t had any itching or a persistent urge to scratch. I also haven’t noticed any new rashes or skin changes anywhere on my body."

turns.doctor_question: Do you have any trouble raising your arms above your head?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I don’t have trouble raising my arms above my head. I can move them normally, and I haven’t noticed any weakness or pain with that movement.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any loss of vision that isn’t accompanied by pain?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any loss of vision, with or without pain. I haven’t noticed any eye symptoms like blurriness or visual changes either.”

turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any fever at all—nothing like extremely high temperatures or feeling dizzy or very uncomfortable. I’ve just had the intermittent flank pain over the past five months.”

turns.patient_answer: “Not really, doctor—I wouldn’t say I’ve been unusually stressed or overwhelmed. My main issue has been the intermittent flank pain, and I haven’t noticed major changes in my daily functioning otherwise.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you experienced any burning or discomfort when you urinate?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t been having burning or discomfort when I urinate recently. I’ve had urinary tract infections in the past, but over the last five months it’s mainly been the intermittent flank pain without noticeable urinary discomfort.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been feeling chills lately?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had chills. I’ve mainly just had intermittent flank pain for the past five months, without fever or feeling unwell.”
